sections.content: Defines the acceptance command registry for slices S0 through S3 and terminal execution. Commands run pytest and terminal_full.py with repository-relative paths, bounded timeouts, and no authorization entries.
sections.title: command-registry.v1.json

sections.content: Specifies the plan-ready acceptance coordinator contract. Four slices cover identity and authority, deterministic routing, idempotency and recovery, and the one-shot coordinator. Changes are limited to designated skill scripts, documentation, and tests; protected platform, runtime, logs, and knowledge paths are forbidden.
sections.title: implementation-contract.v1.json

sections.content: Defines acceptance behavior for S0-S3: bind receipts to candidate and runner identity, machine-select deterministic routes, replay immutable results with successor recovery, and run a reentrant coordinator that follows the action DAG, records telemetry, and stops semantic routes at the explicit handoff boundary. Non-goals exclude daemons, deterministic Bootstrap invocation, knowledge publication, lifecycle changes, and historical evidence rewrites.
sections.title: requirements-and-acceptance.md
